t_raise: Family, family, everybody look at me, I have a question and you all answer: {topic}
Okay, family, open wide, here comes a question: {topic}
berat_tinker.t_react_warm: Ah, {name}, that's beautiful, come here, I need to hug somebody now.
berat_tinker.t_react_laugh: No, {name}, stop, I'm laughing so hard my fillings hurt, and I did my own fillings!
berat_tinker.t_react_tease: That's it, {name}? My patients said more than that with a drill in their mouth.
berat_tinker.t_react_same: The same, {name}, exactly the same, we're family now, it's official, I'm writing it down.
berat_tinker.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, my dear, your turn, open wide and tell us everything.
berat_tinker.t_guess_player: Look at {player}, smiling and saying nothing, like a patient hiding a cavity. We'll get it out of you.
berat_tinker.topic_miss_most: Breakfast in Izmir, family, a whole table, thirty little plates, cheese and olives and honey, and the whole building shouting from the windows.
berat_tinker.topic_first_night: In a cowshed with a cow who had a very bad tooth. I fixed it with my multitool, and she let me sleep against her. Best patient I ever had.
berat_tinker.topic_worst_shift: A man came in screaming that a filling had fallen out, and it was a sunflower seed. He shouted at me for an hour about the bill anyway.
berat_tinker.topic_last_meal: Boyoz from the cart near the clock tower, warm, with a boiled egg and tea, and the sea right there.
berat_tinker.topic_useless_skill: I can tell your whole life story from your teeth, family. Here everybody's teeth are terrifying, so I stopped looking.
berat_tinker.topic_here_better: People here let me help them, family, without an appointment and without a bill. Do you know how good that feels?
berat_tinker.topic_kid_trouble: I pulled my cousin's loose tooth with a door and a string at seven, and the door came off, and the tooth stayed in.
berat_tinker.topic_settle_down: A big house with too many rooms, family in every one, and a little clinic on the ground floor with a very good chair.

t_raise: Right, you lot, question, and I'm not asking twice: {topic}
Go on then, while the kettle's on, everyone answers: {topic}
dan_warrior.t_react_warm: That's a good 'un, {name}, that is. Don't make me say it again.
dan_warrior.t_react_laugh: Give over, {name}, that's daft, I nearly spat my tea out.
dan_warrior.t_react_tease: Is that it, {name}? Bloody hell, I've had more fun in a dentist's waiting room.
dan_warrior.t_react_same: Same, {name}, near enough, and I'm not having a moment about it.
dan_warrior.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, go on, love, crack on. Nobody's getting out of this.
dan_warrior.t_guess_player: {player}'s keeping schtum, which means it's summat embarrassing. I'll get it out of them eventually.
dan_warrior.topic_miss_most: A proper brew, you lot, Yorkshire Tea, milk, two sugars, in a mug that's never been washed properly. Nowt like it.
dan_warrior.topic_first_night: Sat with my back to a rock and my hard hat on, waiting for somebody to tell me what shift I was on, and nobody ever did.
dan_warrior.topic_worst_shift: Ladle came off the hook at two in the morning, molten steel all over the floor, and we all just stood there for a second. Nobody hurt, thank God.
dan_warrior.topic_last_meal: Fish and chips off Sheffield Road, mushy peas, scraps, and plenty of vinegar. Eaten out the paper on a wall.
dan_warrior.topic_useless_skill: I can tell the temperature of steel by the colour of it, near enough to the degree. Not a lot of steel here, is there.
dan_warrior.topic_here_better: Nobody here has a clipboard, you lot. Not one manager, not one form. I could cry.
dan_warrior.topic_kid_trouble: Pinched a pigeon off a lad's loft at ten and kept it in my wardrobe. It flew home the next morning and grassed me up.
dan_warrior.topic_settle_down: Somewhere with a pub that does a proper pint and a quiet corner. That's all I want, I'm a simple lad.

t_raise: Ladies and gents, a question, and I'll know if you lie: {topic}
A little game for the fire, ladies and gents, everyone plays: {topic}
silas_rogue.t_react_warm: That's a nice one, {name}. Honest weight, no false bottom.
silas_rogue.t_react_laugh: Well played, {name}. I didn't see that coming, and I see most things coming.
silas_rogue.t_react_tease: That's a cover story, {name}, and not a good one. I've seen better lies on a customs form.
silas_rogue.t_react_same: Mine's identical, {name}, which is either a coincidence or you've been reading my manifest.
silas_rogue.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Heads you tell the truth, tails you tell us anyway.
silas_rogue.t_guess_player: {player}'s doing the thing where they look interested and say nothing. I respect it, I invented it.
silas_rogue.topic_miss_most: The port of Antwerp at night, ladies and gents, the cranes lit up like birthday cakes, ten thousand containers and every one of them a secret.
silas_rogue.topic_first_night: In a crate on a dock, of all places. Felt right at home, and it was still the worst night's sleep of my life.
silas_rogue.topic_worst_shift: Let's say I once spent twelve hours keeping an eye on a box that turned out to be full of rubber ducks. Thousands of them. I still don't know why.
silas_rogue.topic_last_meal: Frites from a stand near the Grote Markt, in a paper cone, with too much mayonnaise and a cold beer.
silas_rogue.topic_useless_skill: I can tell you what's in a box by how the man carrying it walks. Here everybody walks like they're carrying a dead goblin.
silas_rogue.topic_here_better: Nobody here has heard of me, ladies and gents. For a man like me, ladies and gents, that's the whole prize.
silas_rogue.topic_kid_trouble: I sold the neighbours their own garden gnomes back, at nine, and only got caught on the fourth gnome.
silas_rogue.topic_settle_down: Near a port, with a window that sees every road in and out. And a back door, obviously.

t_raise: Class, a question, and everybody answers, including the back row: {topic}
A small lesson for the evening, everyone. Here's the question: {topic}
pavlo_knight.t_react_warm: Excellent, {name}, top marks, and I don't give those often.
pavlo_knight.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, that's wonderful, the whole class will remember it.
pavlo_knight.t_react_tease: Oh, {name}, I'd write see me at the bottom of that one.
pavlo_knight.t_react_same: I'd have said exactly that, {name}. Interesting, isn't it? History repeats itself, even at a campfire.
pavlo_knight.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? You've been very quiet at the back. Your answer, please.
pavlo_knight.t_guess_player: {player} is the student who knows the answer and won't put a hand up. I've taught a hundred of them.
pavlo_knight.topic_miss_most: The trams in Lviv, class, the old ones, rattling over the cobbles in the snow, with the cathedral bells going at the same time.
pavlo_knight.topic_first_night: In a ruin, an old church I think, reading the carvings by the light of my own fear. I learned three things before morning.
pavlo_knight.topic_worst_shift: An inspector came to watch my lesson on the day the whole class had decided to say nothing at all. Forty five minutes of silence.
pavlo_knight.topic_last_meal: Varenyky with potato and fried onions, and sour cream, and a coffee from the little place behind the opera house.
pavlo_knight.topic_useless_skill: I can tell you every Polish king in order with the dates. Nobody here has ever heard of Poland, so the kings are wasted.
pavlo_knight.topic_here_better: History here is still happening, class. I'm not teaching it, I'm standing in it, and that's frightening and wonderful.
pavlo_knight.topic_kid_trouble: I wrote a fake history of my school at twelve and slipped it into the library. They used it in assemblies for three years.
pavlo_knight.topic_settle_down: A small house near a library, with students who come for tea and stay arguing until midnight.

t_raise: Passengers, attention please, a question before the next stop: {topic}
Everybody, listen, a question, and you answer in order: {topic}
ivan_warrior.t_react_warm: Good, {name}, you are a good passenger, I approve.
ivan_warrior.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, very funny. I laughed, look, it's on my face, it happens.
ivan_warrior.t_react_tease: That's it, {name}? Route 13 at four in the morning is more exciting, and nobody is on it.
ivan_warrior.t_react_same: Me too, {name}, so we agree, and that never happens.
ivan_warrior.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, your stop now. Tell us, then the next passenger.
ivan_warrior.t_guess_player: {player} is quiet like somebody who missed their stop. I know the face, I've seen it ten thousand times.
ivan_warrior.topic_miss_most: The depot at four in the morning, passengers, the trams waiting in rows, all the lights on, and tea from the machine that tastes of metal.
ivan_warrior.topic_first_night: On the edge of a road, standing up, waiting for something to come, like a tram stop, but nothing came, so I stood all night.
ivan_warrior.topic_worst_shift: Minus thirty eight, the points froze, and I sat in a dead tram with eleven angry passengers for two hours. They blamed me personally.
ivan_warrior.topic_last_meal: Pelmeni, a lot of them, with sour cream and black pepper, and a little vodka to keep them company.
ivan_warrior.topic_useless_skill: I can tell you the time to the minute without a watch. Here nobody is on time, so it only makes me angry.
ivan_warrior.topic_here_better: No timetable, passengers. At first it was terrible, now it's a little bit nice, and don't tell anybody.
ivan_warrior.topic_kid_trouble: I drove my uncle's car into a snowbank at eleven, very slowly, very carefully. It took six men to pull it out.
ivan_warrior.topic_settle_down: A small flat by a station, with a window on the platform, so I can watch everybody arrive late.

t_raise: All of you, a question, and please, consider it before you answer: {topic}
I have a question for the evening. Answer slowly, if you can: {topic}
haruto_runemaster.t_react_warm: That is a fine answer, {name}. It has good form.
haruto_runemaster.t_react_laugh: That is very funny, {name}. I am laughing, inside, where it is appropriate.
haruto_runemaster.t_react_tease: That answer was written in a hurry, {name}. I would ask you to do it again, with care.
haruto_runemaster.t_react_same: My answer is the same, {name}. I find that I don't mind.
haruto_runemaster.t_ask_player: And you, {player}. Your answer, please, and take whatever time you need.
haruto_runemaster.t_guess_player: {player} is choosing the answer the way one chooses the first stroke. We will wait.
haruto_runemaster.topic_miss_most: The sound of ink being ground on the stone before dawn in my studio in Kanazawa, all of you, and the light coming up over the garden.
haruto_runemaster.topic_first_night: In a cave, sitting very straight, reciting the order of strokes for every character I know, to keep my mind in order. It worked, mostly.
haruto_runemaster.topic_worst_shift: A wedding commission, two hundred invitations, and the client changed the bride's name after I had finished. It was a different bride.
haruto_runemaster.topic_last_meal: Fresh crab from the Omicho market in winter, cold sake, and rice, eaten slowly at a counter with the snow outside.
haruto_runemaster.topic_useless_skill: I can write my name in forty seven styles. Nobody here can read any of them, which is humbling.
haruto_runemaster.topic_here_better: Here the marks I make actually do something, all of you. On Earth a stroke was only beautiful. Here it is also true.
haruto_runemaster.topic_kid_trouble: I wrote a rude word on my teacher's door at nine, in very good calligraphy. He made me write it a hundred more times, properly.
haruto_runemaster.topic_settle_down: A small room with good light, a garden I can see from the desk, and quiet. That is enough.

t_raise: Everyone, a question, in sequence please, one at a time: {topic}
All stations, a question for the frequency, answer in turn: {topic}
minh_chronomancer.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, say again, I need to hear that one twice.
minh_chronomancer.t_react_tease: Negative, {name}, I've had more detail from a pilot who forgot his call sign.
minh_chronomancer.t_react_same: {name}, we're on the same heading there. I didn't expect that.
minh_chronomancer.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, you're next in the sequence, so go ahead, I'm listening.
minh_chronomancer.t_guess_player: {player} is holding position and saying nothing. Very professional, I'd allow it on my frequency.
minh_chronomancer.topic_miss_most: The radar room at three in the morning, everyone, the green sweep, the quiet, two aircraft talking to me from very far away.
minh_chronomancer.topic_first_night: On a rooftop, counting stars in sectors so I would have something orderly to do. I reached nine hundred and forty before dawn.
minh_chronomancer.topic_worst_shift: A storm cell over the airport, eleven aircraft holding, one of them low on fuel. Everyone landed, and then I sat in the car for an hour.
minh_chronomancer.topic_last_meal: Pho from the street near the airport, at four in the morning, after a night shift, with too many herbs and too much chilli.
minh_chronomancer.topic_useless_skill: I can hold twelve moving things in my head and keep them apart. Here it's mostly useful for watching the cooking.
minh_chronomancer.topic_here_better: Nobody here is waiting for me to make a mistake, everyone. It took me a year to stop listening for it.
minh_chronomancer.topic_kid_trouble: I rerouted the whole school's bicycle traffic at twelve with chalk arrows. It worked better than the teachers' plan, and I was punished for a week.
minh_chronomancer.topic_settle_down: Somewhere high, with a wide view and a clear sky, so I can see everything coming a long way off.

t_raise: Friends, tea is poured, so here is a question for the fire: {topic}
Sit, friends, and answer me this, slowly, like tea: {topic}
bakyt_hunter.t_react_warm: Jakshy, {name}, that is a good answer. It warms me like tea.
bakyt_hunter.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, very funny, even my eagle laughed, and she never laughs.
bakyt_hunter.t_react_tease: This is your answer, {name}? A lamb would say more, and a lamb says only one thing.
bakyt_hunter.t_react_same: {name}, we walk the same road, you and I, it was my answer too.
bakyt_hunter.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Drink, and then answer. There is no hurry on the mountain.
bakyt_hunter.t_guess_player: {player} is quiet like the sky before snow. Something is coming, friends, we only wait.
bakyt_hunter.topic_miss_most: The summer pasture, friends, the yurt open to the wind, the horses on the hill, and the stars so close you could put them in your pocket.
bakyt_hunter.topic_first_night: On the open ground with my eagle on my arm, both of us looking at the wrong sky. She was not happy with me.
bakyt_hunter.topic_worst_shift: A wolf came for the sheep in a snowstorm, and I followed it for two days. I found it, and then I let it go.
bakyt_hunter.topic_last_meal: Beshbarmak, the whole family's portion, the meat and noodles with your hands, and a lot of kumis after.
bakyt_hunter.topic_useless_skill: I can tell which horse is coming by the sound of its feet on the ground. Here the horses are not mine, so they don't care.
bakyt_hunter.topic_here_better: The wild here is very big, friends. I thought the Tian Shan was the biggest place in the world, and it was not.
bakyt_hunter.topic_kid_trouble: I rode my uncle's best horse into the next valley at nine without asking, and came back with a girl's ribbon and a very sore backside.
bakyt_hunter.topic_settle_down: Somewhere with mountains and a pasture and room for a yurt. Not a house, friends, a house doesn't move.

t_raise: Cabros, a question, everyone, one by one: {topic}
I ask something, cabros, and you answer, ya: {topic}
matias_reaper.t_react_warm: Ya, {name}, I like this one, it's true.
matias_reaper.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, very good, cachai, you made me laugh, it's rare.
matias_reaper.t_react_tease: That's all, {name}? A bus ticket has more words on it.
matias_reaper.t_react_same: Mine too, {name}, same stop, same bus.
matias_reaper.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Your turn, ya. We wait for you.
matias_reaper.t_guess_player: {player} is like the quiet passenger at the back. Always the best stories, never telling them.
matias_reaper.topic_miss_most: The bus at six in the morning, cabros, the same forty faces, the old lady with the dog, the boy with the trumpet, everybody going somewhere.
matias_reaper.topic_first_night: Under a bridge, sitting, waiting, like waiting for the last bus. I said good night to nobody, from habit.
matias_reaper.topic_worst_shift: A man paid his fare in coins, all small coins, two thousand pesos, while the whole bus watched. It took eleven minutes.
matias_reaper.topic_last_meal: A completo from the stand near the Alameda, with avocado and tomato and too much mayonnaise. Two of them, cabros.
matias_reaper.topic_useless_skill: I can tell where you will get off the bus by how you hold the rail. Here there is no bus, so I only guess.
matias_reaper.topic_here_better: Here people look at me, cabros. On the bus I was a machine that gives tickets.
matias_reaper.topic_kid_trouble: I rode the whole bus route at ten without paying, end to end, three times. The driver knew, and he let me.
matias_reaper.topic_settle_down: Near a road, a busy one, where people pass every day and say good morning.

t_raise: Okay, crew, a question before the lights go down: {topic}
Crew, listen, one question, and everybody answers it: {topic}
tomas_warrior.t_react_warm: That's a good one, {name}, really. A clean answer, no slack in it.
tomas_warrior.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, brilliant, I'll tell that one on every load in.
tomas_warrior.t_react_tease: That's it, {name}? I've heard more drama from a truss being unbolted.
tomas_warrior.t_react_same: Same for me, {name}, the same exactly, we're on the same line.
tomas_warrior.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, your turn. Everybody else is clipped in, so go.
tomas_warrior.t_guess_player: {player}'s not saying, crew, which on a rig usually means somebody did something stupid. We'll find out.
tomas_warrior.topic_miss_most: The grid above a stage at the start of a show, crew, the house lights going down and ten thousand people going quiet underneath you.
tomas_warrior.topic_first_night: Up a tree, tied in with a sling I had on me, of course. Very professional, very uncomfortable, and I didn't fall.
tomas_warrior.topic_worst_shift: A load out in the rain in Vienna, a truss jammed at forty feet, and the band's manager shouting at me from the ground the whole time.
tomas_warrior.topic_last_meal: Svickova with dumplings and cranberries, and a Pilsner so cold it hurts, at the pub round the corner from my flat.
tomas_warrior.topic_useless_skill: I can tie off a load faster than anybody I've met. Here mostly I'm tying up packs, which is a waste of my gift.
tomas_warrior.topic_here_better: Nobody here hangs things over the audience, crew. Fewer things to fall on people, I sleep better.
tomas_warrior.topic_kid_trouble: I climbed the scaffolding on the church in our street at eleven and hung a flag at the top. The priest was angry, and also very impressed.
tomas_warrior.topic_settle_down: Somewhere with high beams and a good pub. A theatre, maybe, if anybody builds one here.
